Subject: POC: scope & success criteria — next steps

Hi Sana / James —

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC plan: 

POC goals (what success looks like)
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 300ms on your typical 75-token prompt distribution for interactive flows.
- Quality: match or exceed your baseline for extractive QA F1 on the dataset we discussed (target +8-10 points over current internal baseline).
- Cost: Demonstrate a projected hosted inference cost below $0.80 per 1k tokens (model/config dependent).
- Operational: ability to route to fallback model when capacity constrained; show traceability for every request (audit logs).

Evaluation plan
- Redwood will deploy a dedicated POC instance and run 2 representative workloads: (1) product QA bot (primary), (2) search re-ranker (secondary).
- You will provide a labeled holdout set for QA (we discussed 1k queries) and a small sample for re-ranking.
- We'll run nightly batch evals + representative interactive testing; we will share dashboards and per-route metrics.

Timeline
- Proposed POC start: 2026-05-25
- Baseline evaluation period: 4 weeks (2026-05-25 to 2026-06-22)
- Checkpoint syncs: weekly (Thursdays) + final review during week of 2026-06-22

Ownership
- Acme SME / primary contact: Sana Ahmed
- Redwood PM: Marissa Cole
- Redwood Eng lead: Dev Patel
- Redwood CS support: Priyom Das / Rachel Kim

Attachments: POC-Plan-Acme-v1.pdf (detailed plan + success criteria).

Please confirm the timeline and owners. If we’re aligned, I’ll issue the SOW draft and schedule the kickoff for 2026-05-25.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — this looks solid. A couple of asks from our side after chatting with the product team: 

1) We want to add a third evaluation use case: outbound email summarization (summarize long customer threads into 3–4 bullet points). This is high priority for our CS workflows.
2) We can share a small sample dataset (10k rows) for the summarization task — attaching a CSV export.

Question: How does adding this use case affect the timeline and success criteria? Would you consider this an add-on (phase 2) or can it be folded into the main 4-week POC?

Appreciate a quick take so we can align internally.
